game.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

lede: Carolina Panthers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#13 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Carolina Panthers -3.1 with a fair total of 44.1 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Carolina Panthers pass offence vs Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass defence, which sits +0.126 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Carolina Panthers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
